newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares rise before Easter holiday.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares rise before Easter holiday.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Portuguese shares closed higher after activity centred on Banco Totta e Acores which announced a higher 1996 dividend than initially proposed by the board. BTA closed at 2,530 escudos, up 145, in volume of 331,051.
* Total turnover on Lisbon bourse was a modest 7.2 billion escudos. Some operators squared portfolios ahead of the Easter holiday.

* Other active shares included cement group Cimpor, retailer Sonae and Banco Comercial Portugues. BCP strengthened on news that it had sold its 50 percent stake in Colombo, expected to be one of the biggest shopping centres in Europe. BCP closed at 2,500 escudos, up 45, in volume of 221,977.
* Dealers said Lisbon stock prices on Tuesday would depend on foreign markets, notably the U.S. which re-opens on Monday.
